name: Meals
description: Plan the week's meals for your household, then shop and cook from the plan.

screens.label: Meals
screens.description: The Meals page, with tabs for Plan, Shopping list, Pantry, Household and Log. Plan, Shopping list, Pantry and Log show an empty state until plans can be written.

screens.label: Household
screens.description: Who eats, each person's meals of the day, Never serve list, preferences and optional calorie target.

screens.label: Meals settings
screens.description: Units (US or metric) and the default Pantry mode.

features.description: Add or change household members through Moss.
Ask Moss to plan any number of days up to 28. Days are written one by one. Stop, resume, or retry one day.
Every meal is checked against each eater's Never serve list. Packaged or branded ingredients carry a check-the-label note.

assistantActionFamilies.label: Meal planning
assistantActionFamilies.description: Plan meals, manage the household, list, Pantry and cooking.

assistantTools.name: meals.kitchen.get
assistantTools.description: Read the Meals kitchen: units, default Pantry mode, every household member with their meals of the day, Never serve list, preferences and targets, and the Shared or Solo rule for each meal. Creates the kitchen and a self member named You on first use.

assistantTools.name: meals.kitchen.save
assistantTools.description: Change kitchen settings: units, the default Pantry mode for new plans, and Shared or Solo rules per meal. Each slot rule given replaces the stored rule for that meal name; other rules stay.

defaultPantryMode.description: ignore: plan without the Pantry. prefer: use what is on hand where it fits. only: plan only from what is on hand.

slotName.description: Meal of the day, for example dinner.

soloWeekdays.description: ISO weekdays (1 = Monday, 7 = Sunday) when each person eats this meal on their own. Empty means shared every day.

usualTime.description: Usual time as HH:MM, or null.

assistantTools.name: meals.household.save
assistantTools.description: Add or change a household member. Leave memberId out to add someone (name required). Restrictions are strict Never serve items; preferences are soft likes and dislikes. Null clears an optional field.

memberId.description: Member to change. Leave out to add a new member.

linkedAccountEmail.description: Their Moss account email, if they have one.

mealPattern.description: Meals of the day this person eats. Defaults to breakfast, lunch and dinner.

restrictions.description: Never serve: allergies, diets and foods this person must not be served, for example peanuts or vegetarian.

assistantTools.name: meals.household.remove
assistantTools.description: Remove a household member. The self member cannot be removed.

assistantTools.name: meals.plan.create
assistantTools.description: Start a meal plan of 1 to 28 days from a start date. Moss writes the days one at a time in the background, checking every meal against each eater's Never serve list and calorie target, and returns the plan at once with its days pending. Call meals.plan.get to follow progress. Reusing an idempotency key returns the plan that key already made.

startDate.description: First day of the plan, YYYY-MM-DD, in the user's own calendar.

pantryMode.description: Leave out to use the kitchen default.

requestText.description: What the user asked for, in their words, for example quick dinners and more fish.

allowRepeats.description: True lets a dish from the last seven days come back.

idempotencyKey.description: A fresh value per request, so a retried call does not start a second plan.

assistantTools.name: meals.plan.get
assistantTools.description: Read a meal plan by its id, or the newest plan that covers a date: each day's status, its meals, who eats them, Safety results and calorie fit.

date.description: Find the newest plan that includes this day.

assistantTools.name: meals.plan.control
assistantTools.description: Stop a plan that is being written, resume a stopped or paused plan where it left off, or retry one day that failed. A retry keeps the day's finished meals and rewrites only the rest. Name the day by dayId or date.

assistantTools.name: meals.plan.delete
assistantTools.description: Delete a meal plan with all its days and meals.

assistantTools.name: meals.meal.get
assistantTools.description: Read one planned meal as a recipe: steps, ingredients scaled to the servings, check-the-label notes, and each eater's portion, Safety result and calorie fit.
